decks.notes: This Orzhov Aggro deck focuses on aggressive creature plays backed up by removal and disruption spells to control the board and maintain pressure on the opponent. By utilizing efficient creatures like Deep-Cavern Bat and Haliya, Guided by Light, alongside powerful spells such as Erode and Lunar Convocation, this deck aims to quickly overwhelm the opponent and close out the game before they have a chance to stabilize. With a mix of creatures, removal, and disruption, this deck is designed to maintain a strong board presence and apply constant pressure to secure victory.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly establish board presence and apply pressure on the opponent using cheap spells and efficient creatures. The deck focuses on tempo plays, utilizing cards like Boomerang Basics and Slickshot Show-Off to disrupt the opponent's game plan while developing its own board. Eddymurk Crab and Hearth Elemental provide additional threats, while spells like Burst Lightning and Stormchaser's Talent offer direct damage and removal options. The mana base is carefully constructed to ensure consistency and access to the necessary colors for the deck's spells.

The focus of this deck is to rapidly play low-cost spells to put pressure on the opponent, utilizing efficient creatures like Eddymurk Crab and Slickshot Show-Off. The inclusion of cards like Flow State and Stormchaser's Talent allows for spell recursion and additional damage output. The deck also includes various instant spells for removal and protection, such as Burst Lightning and Spell Pierce. With a mix of card draw and mana fixing, this deck aims to maintain tempo while overwhelming the opponent with a steady stream of aggression.

This deck focuses on quickly attacking the opponent with low-cost creatures and spells, using cards like Slickshot Show-Off and Elusive Otter to deal damage. It also utilizes cards like Wild Ride and Stormchaser's Talent to boost the power of its creatures. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a fast and aggressive strategy, while also including card draw and control elements to maintain pressure and dominate the game. It relies on tempo and efficient use of resources to secure victory.

This deck focuses on quickly overwhelming opponents with aggressive creatures and spells, utilizing a mix of direct damage, bounce effects, and evasion to maintain control of the board. The key strategy is to constantly apply pressure and disrupt the opponent's game plan while maintaining card advantage and flexibility through card draw and mana fixing. By efficiently deploying threats and disrupting the opponent's plays, this UR Aggro deck aims to quickly close out games before the opponent can stabilize.

This deck focuses on using low-cost spells and creatures to quickly overwhelm the opponent with damage. The key strategy is to efficiently control the board while continually putting pressure on the opponent. Cards like Boomerang Basics and Burst Lightning help to clear the way for your creatures to attack, while Sleight of Hand and Opt allow for card selection and draw power. Eddymurk Crab and Slickshot Show-Off provide solid bodies to attack with, and Spell Pierce can help protect your creatures or spells from removal. Overall, the deck aims to win by maintaining a fast and aggressive pace throughout the game.

The deck focuses on utilizing control spells to disrupt the opponent's game plan while gradually building up its own board presence. Cards like Eddymurk Crab and Hearth Elemental help control the board, while Flow State and Prismari Charm provide additional removal and card advantage. Impractical Joke adds a bit of chaos to the mix. The mana base is carefully crafted to allow for both consistent and flexible casting of spells. Overall, the deck aims to outlast opponents through a combination of disruption and incremental advantage.

This deck focuses on quickly overwhelming the opponent with strong creatures, using ramp cards like Llanowar Elves to get out threats early. Earthbender Ascension and Sapling Nursery provide extra value by generating more tokens. Cards like Ba Sing Se and Snakeskin Veil protect your creatures from removal spells, while Mightform Harmonizer and Surrak, Elusive Hunter help pump up your team for lethal attacks. The deck also includes some control elements like Demolition Field to deal with opposing threats. Overall, the strategy of this deck is to apply constant pressure and finish off the opponent before they can stabilize.

The deck focuses on a fast-paced aggressive strategy with a mix of control elements. It aims to quickly overwhelm the opponent with efficient creatures like Avatar's Wrath and Aang, Swift Savior, supported by disruptive spells like Spell Pierce and Erode. The deck also benefits from card draw and resilience with cards like Enduring Curiosity and Floodpits Drowner. Overall, the deck seeks to establish board presence early on and maintain pressure throughout the game, utilizing a mix of white and blue creatures and spells to secure victory.

The main focus of this deck is to utilize a combination of control spells and utility cards to outmaneuver and overwhelm the opponent. By using a mix of counterspells, removal, and card advantage, the player aims to disrupt the opponent's strategy while setting up their own win conditions. The deck also includes a range of land cards to ensure consistency and stability in mana production. Ultimately, the goal is to maintain control of the game through strategic decision-making and resource management, leading to a decisive victory.

The deck focuses on overwhelming the opponent with aggressive creatures and efficient removal spells to clear the way for attacks. It utilizes a mix of creature types and abilities to maintain board presence and pressure the opponent. The mana base is built to support a fast and consistent curve, allowing the deck to quickly deploy threats and maintain pressure throughout the game. Overall, the deck aims to win through early aggression and efficient combat tricks, while also having some resilience against removal and board wipes.

The main concept of this UR Aggro deck is to quickly deploy low-cost creatures and spells to put pressure on the opponent and win the game as fast as possible. By using efficient cards like Burst Lightning and Slickshot Show-Off, combined with Eddymurk Crab and Flow State to control the board, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive plays. The deck also includes some tempo and card draw options like Opt and Sleight of Hand to ensure consistency and maintain a steady flow of threats. With a mix of direct damage, creature aggression, and control elements, this deck aims to win the game through fast and relentless attacks.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly establish a board presence and overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures. The deck utilizes efficient mana ramp with Llanowar Elves and Fabled Passage to quickly bring out powerful threats like Badgermole Cub and Sazh's Chocobo. Earthbender Ascension and Mightform Harmonizer provide additional buffs to push for damage, while cards like Snakeskin Veil and Meltstrider's Resolve protect key creatures. Escape Tunnel and Demolition Field offer additional utility and disruption, while cards like Esper Origins and Keen-Eyed Curator provide card advantage and additional options in longer games.

This deck focuses on building a strong board presence quickly and overwhelming the opponent with aggressive creatures. By utilizing efficient mana ramp cards like Llanowar Elves and Earthbender Ascension, the deck can quickly deploy threats like Sazh's Chocobo and Mossborn Hydra. The deck also includes disruptive elements like Demolition Field and Erode to control the board and keep the pressure on the opponent. Overall, the strategy centers around playing creatures early and often to swarm the opponent and win the game through fast and efficient beatdowns.

This deck focuses on maintaining control of the board through various spells and creatures while building up resources through cards like Esper Origins and Tablet of Discovery. With a mix of removal spells like Abrade and Flashback, as well as threats like Leatherhead, Swamp Stalker, this deck aims to dominate the game and overwhelm the opponent with a combination of control and powerful creatures.

This UR Aggro deck focuses on quickly building up a board presence and dealing damage to the opponent using cards like Burst Lightning, Stormchaser's Talent, and Slickshot Show-Off. The deck also includes ways to manipulate the opponent's board and protect your own creatures with cards like Boomerang Basics and Get Out. The archetype's goal is to control the tempo of the game and overwhelm the opponent with efficient aggression and card advantage.
